title: 10 Best Outbound Sales Automation Tools Compared by Experts (2026)
summary: Compare 15 sales outreach tools by channel, automation, CRM and published price: Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, Instantly, lemlist, HubSpot Sales Hub and more.
body_markdown:
A sales outreach tool is software that sends and schedules a sequence of emails, LinkedIn steps, call tasks and texts to a list of prospects and records the replies. For enterprise sales engagement, compare Outreach and Salesloft. For cold email at volume, compare Instantly, Mailshake, Smartlead and Woodpecker. For multichannel outreach with LinkedIn, compare Apollo, Klenty, La Growth Machine, lemlist and Reply.io. For outreach inside the CRM, compare Close, HubSpot Sales Hub and Pipedrive. For the calling step, Trellus dials the call tasks those tools create.


On November 12, 2026, 13 of these 15 products published a price. Each vendor’s lowest paid plan that sends sequences cost from $25 per user a month (Mailshake Starter, billed yearly) to $99 per user a month (Close Growth, billed annually). Outreach and Salesloft publish no price.


*Trellus publishes this guide and is one of the products in it. Details about other products come from each vendor’s own website, read on November 12, 2026. Nothing here is a hands-on test or a ranking; the table is alphabetical.*

## What sales outreach tools cost


Thirteen of the 15 products publish a price. On November 12, 2026, each vendor’s lowest paid plan that sends sequences cost this much a month, lowest first:


- **Mailshake Starter:** $25 per user, billed yearly.
- **Woodpecker Email:** $26, billed annually.
- **Smartlead Base:** $32, billed annually.
- **Pipedrive Growth:** US$39 per seat, billed annually.
- **Instantly Growth:** $47, billed monthly.
- **Apollo Basic:** $49 per seat, billed annually.
- **Reply.io Email Volume:** from $49 per user, billed annually.
- **Klenty Starter:** $50, billed annually.
- **lemlist Email:** $55, billed yearly.
- **La Growth Machine Basic:** $58 per identity, billed yearly.
- **HubSpot Sales Hub Professional:** from $90 per seat, plus a one-time $1,500 onboarding fee.
- **Close Growth:** $99 per user, billed annually.


**Free plans and trials.** Apollo has a free plan with two sequences per team. Close, HubSpot, Klenty, La Growth Machine, lemlist, Pipedrive, Reply.io and Woodpecker list 14-day free trials. Instantly and Smartlead let you start free; Smartlead says no credit card is required. Mailshake has no free trial, and Trellus has no free plan or trial.


**Quote-only products.** Outreach and Salesloft publish no price. Outreach says its pricing combines per-user seats with AI credits, and Salesloft has no pricing page. The top plans of Instantly, lemlist, Mailshake and Woodpecker, and Trellus Business, are custom too.


The price depends on four things:


- **Seats.** Apollo, Close, HubSpot, Mailshake, Pipedrive, Reply.io and Trellus charge per user or seat.
- **Sending mailboxes.** La Growth Machine charges per sending identity. Instantly, Smartlead and Woodpecker include unlimited email accounts.
- **Contacts, emails and credits.** Instantly and Smartlead price by contacts and emails a month, and Woodpecker by emails sent. Apollo uses credits for data and dialer minutes, Outreach adds AI credits, and Close bills calling and SMS by usage.
- **Annual terms.** Annual billing lowers the monthly price: Apollo Basic is $49 instead of $65, and Pipedrive Growth US$39 instead of US$49.


## How automated outreach works


- **The list.** Prospects come from a CRM view, an uploaded file or the tool’s own contact database.
- **The sequence.** A sequence is an ordered set of steps with waits between them: an email, a LinkedIn message, a call task, a text. Salesloft and Klenty call it a cadence. Reply.io and Woodpecker describe sequences that branch on what the prospect does.
- **Sending limits and deliverability.** Vendors cap how much each mailbox sends and warm up new mailboxes so email reaches the inbox. HubSpot limits sequence email to 500 sends per user a day on Professional.
- **Replies.** Instantly, lemlist and Smartlead collect replies in one inbox. Mailshake pauses a sequence when a prospect replies, unsubscribes or bounces, and Outreach pauses one on an out-of-office reply.
- **The call step.** The sequence creates a call task, and a rep places the call by hand or with a dialer.
- **Logging to the CRM.** Each email, reply and call is saved to the contact’s record. Close, HubSpot and Pipedrive are the CRM. Most of the others sync to one.


### What “AI outreach” means on these vendors’ pages


Vendors use the term for two things. The first is AI-written messages. Apollo’s AI Assistant builds sequence steps and copy, Instantly’s Copilot writes sequence copy, and Klenty’s Agentic Cadences write a 1:1 email for each prospect. HubSpot, Mailshake and Pipedrive list an AI email writer or assistant.


The second is AI agents that do part of a rep’s work. Outreach describes agents that act on behalf of sellers. Salesloft’s agents research accounts and draft emails. Reply.io’s Jason AI SDR answers replies and books meetings. Close’s AI Agents, in beta, qualify leads, follow up and book meetings. These are the vendors’ descriptions, not test results.


## How to choose a sales outreach tool


- **Channels.** Check which plan includes each channel reps will use.
- **CRM.** Check that the vendor names your CRM, and ask what is written to the record.
- **Sending setup.** Ask how many mailboxes a plan includes and whether warm-up is included.
- **Replies.** Check that a reply stops the sequence and reaches the right rep.
- **The call step.** Decide whether the built-in dialer is enough or reps need a separate dialer.
- **Pricing unit.** Compare seats, identities, contacts and emails for your own volume.
- **Rules.** Cold email, texts and calls are regulated. For calls, see[calling laws by state](https://www.trellus.ai/calling-laws) .


## Where Trellus fits


Trellus is not a sequencer. It does not send email sequences or automate LinkedIn steps, so a team that needs those needs one of the other tools in the table. Trellus is a Chrome extension that dials the call tasks and lists inside the sequencer or CRM a team already uses. It adds power dialing, one number at a time, and parallel dialing, several numbers at once and up to five lines on eligible plans. The call result is logged back to the same record.


Trellus works with 31 platforms, listed in the[integrations directory](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations) . It dials in 23 of them, with both power and parallel dialing in 22. Eight are in the table above:[Apollo](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/apollo) ,[Close](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/close) ,[HubSpot](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/hubspot) ,[lemlist](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/lemlist) ,[Outreach](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/outreach) ,[Pipedrive](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/pipedrive) ,[Salesloft](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/salesloft) and[Smartlead](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations/smartlead) . What is saved after a call varies by platform.


Live call coaching, which shows a live transcript and suggestions during the call, is on the Business plan. Power is $99.99 per seat per month and Power + Parallel is $149.99, bought online with no seat minimum. Business is custom. There is no free plan and no free trial. ## Frequently asked questions


### What is a sales outreach tool?


A sales outreach tool is software that sends and schedules a sequence of emails, LinkedIn steps, call tasks and texts to a list of prospects and records the replies. Vendors also call it sales outreach software, a sales engagement platform or a sequencer. Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, lemlist and Instantly are examples.


### What are the best sales outreach tools?


No single tool is best for every team. For enterprise sales engagement, compare Outreach and Salesloft. For cold email at volume, compare Instantly, Mailshake, Smartlead and Woodpecker. For multichannel outreach with LinkedIn, compare Apollo, Klenty, La Growth Machine, lemlist and Reply.io. For outreach inside the CRM, compare Close, HubSpot Sales Hub and Pipedrive. For the calling step, Trellus dials the call tasks inside those tools.


### What does an AI outreach tool do?


An AI outreach tool uses AI for part of the outreach work. On these vendors’ pages that means AI that writes the messages, as in Apollo, Instantly and Klenty, or AI agents that do part of a rep’s work, as in Outreach, Salesloft, Close and Reply.io’s Jason AI SDR. Instantly, Smartlead and Woodpecker also use AI to label or sort replies.


### What are the best ways to automate lead outreach with personalized sequences?


Start with a clean list, then build one sequence per audience with a few steps across email, LinkedIn and calls. Personalize with fields from the CRM, or with AI-written lines in tools such as Apollo, Klenty and Reply.io. Keep sending within each mailbox’s limits, stop the sequence when a prospect replies and log every step to the CRM.


### What are the best lead outreach automation tools for marketers who need to send welcome messages automatically?


Tools that send a message when a new lead arrives fit this need. HubSpot describes workflows that enroll prospects in a sequence of timed emails. Close Workflows send emails and SMS. Pipedrive automations send a personalized email when a chosen event happens. Instantly describes workflows that trigger a campaign when a lead visits the site or replies.


### What is the difference between outreach tools, sales automation tools and a CRM?


An outreach tool sends sequences of messages to prospects. Sales automation tools are the wider group: software that automates sales work such as lead routing, task creation and follow-up. A CRM is the record of contacts, companies and deals. Close, HubSpot and Pipedrive build outreach into the CRM, and most of the other tools here sync to one.


### How much does sales outreach software cost?


On November 12, 2026, each vendor’s lowest paid plan that sends sequences cost from $25 per user a month (Mailshake Starter, billed yearly) to $99 per user a month (Close Growth, billed annually). Apollo has a free plan with two sequences per team. Outreach and Salesloft publish no price. Seats, sending mailboxes, contacts or credits and the billing term change the total.


### Which sales outreach tools include a dialer, and when is a separate dialer used?


Apollo, Close, Klenty, lemlist, Mailshake, Outreach, Reply.io, Salesloft and Smartlead describe a built-in dialer. Teams add a separate dialer when the outreach tool has none, or when they want power or parallel dialing on the same call tasks. Trellus is one, and more are in the[outbound auto dialer comparison](https://www.trellus.ai/post/outbound-auto-dialer-software) .
